issues.problem: Suffix comparative aliases were being presented without a learner note, although the usual comparison uses more or most modest.
issues.resolution: The author removed the suffix aliases and stated the usual periphrastic comparison. The saved card was reread.

issues.problem: The elder/eldest aliases lacked restrictions and could be mistaken for general replacements for older/oldest.
issues.resolution: The author added the ordinary comparison versus family-seniority distinction and the restriction against elder than. The saved full card was reread.

issues.problem: The paths example used the unnatural collocation meet different entrances.
issues.resolution: The author revised it to paths leading to different entrances while keeping the Chinese aligned. The saved example was reread.
